source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: the Chapter 11 exercise solved (PDF 255-257), every question with an easy model answer and Wazahat boxes.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 11 (Human Circulatory System) ki exercise hai, kitab ki tarteeb mein, hal ke saath. Kitab MCQs ki answer key nahi deti; har MCQ ka jawab chapter se nikal kar wajah ke saath diya gaya hai. Short sawalon ke jawab mukhtasar aur long sawalon ke poore number wale model jawab hain. Jahan zaroorat hai, "Wazahat" box mein aasan alfaaz mein samjhaya gaya hai.
Multiple Choice Questions (kai jawabon mein se sahi chunein)

blocks.prompt:
1. Compared to vein, an artery;
(Vein ke muqable mein artery ...)

options.text: Zyada satah (jild) ke qareeb hoti hai
Organ se blood door le jati hai

blocks.explanation: Artery ki deewar moti aur muscular hoti hai aur is mein valves nahi hote, kyun ke us mein blood dil ke tez pressure se chalta hai; veins mein semilunar valves hote hain jo blood ko wapas jane se rokte hain. (c) is shakal mein sahi nahi: artery blood ko dil se door, lekin organ ki TARAF le jati hai; organ se door blood vein le jati hai.

blocks.prompt:
2. Bicuspid valve guards the opening between;
(Bicuspid valve kin ke darmiyan wale raaste ki hifazat karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Bicuspid (mitral) valve, jis ke do cusps (parde) hain, left atrium aur left ventricle ke darmiyan hota hai; tricuspid valve right atrium aur right ventricle ke darmiyan.

blocks.prompt:
3. What is the state of bicuspid and tricuspid valves at the end of the first heart sound?
(Dil ki pehli awaaz ke aakhir mein bicuspid aur tricuspid valves ki kya halat hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Pehli awaaz "lubb" tab aati hai jab dono ventricles contract hote hain aur tricuspid aur bicuspid valves aik saath band hote hain; is liye dono band hain.

blocks.prompt:
4. By beating at normal speed, our heart pumps how much blood per minute?
(Normal raftaar se dharakte hue dil har minute kitna blood pump karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Aam baaligh ka dil minute mein taqreeban 70 dafa dharakta hai aur har minute poora blood, taqreeban 5 litre, pump karta hai.

blocks.prompt:
5. Closure of tricuspid and bicuspid valves produces sound;
(Tricuspid aur bicuspid valves ke band hone se kaun si awaaz aati hai?)
blocks.explanation: Ventricles contract hone par tricuspid aur bicuspid valves band hote hain aur "lubb" ki awaaz aati hai; "dubb" semilunar valves ke band hone se aati hai.

blocks.prompt:
6. SA-node initiates heartbeat in;
(SA-node dil ki dharkan kahan shuru karta hai?)

options.text: Right atrium aur kuch left mein bhi
Left atrium aur kuch right mein bhi

blocks.explanation: SA node (right atrium ki oopar wali deewar mein) atria ki deewaron ko signals bhejta hai aur dono atria aik saath contract hote hain.

blocks.prompt:
7. Systolic pressure in young man is;
(Jawan aadmi mein systolic pressure kitna hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Normal jawan mein systolic pressure 120 mm Hg aur diastolic taqreeban 75-85 mm Hg hota hai (120/80 likhte hain).

blocks.prompt:
8. Blood pressure is highest in _____ and blood moves most slowly in;
(Blood pressure sab se zyada ____ mein aur blood sab se aahista ____ mein chalta hai.)
blocks.explanation: Blood pressure aorta aur arteries mein sab se zyada hota hai; blood ki raftaar capillaries mein sab se kam (taqreeban 1 mm/sec) hoti hai kyun ke un ka kul cross-section sab se bara hai.

blocks.prompt:
9. Instead of normal “lub-dubb” sound, a “lub-hiss, lub-hiss” sound indicates;
(Normal "lub-dubb" ki jagah "lub-hiss" ki awaaz kis cheez ki nishani hai?)
blocks.explanation: "Dubb" semilunar valves ke band hone se aati hai. Agar valve poora band na ho to turbulence (khalal) murmur ki shakal mein sunai deta hai jo "hiss" jaisa hota hai. "Dubb" ki jagah hiss ka matlab semilunar valve kharab hai.

blocks.prompt:
10. In humans which one is the other system for the transport of materials, than blood circulatory system?
(Insaan mein blood circulatory system ke ilawa materials ke transport ka doosra system kaun sa hai?)
blocks.explanation: Insaan mein transport ke do system hain: blood circulatory system aur lymphatic system.

blocks.prompt:
1. What is the main difference between the walls of an artery and a vein?
Artery aur vein ki deewaron mein bara farq kya hai?
blocks.explanation: Dono mein teen tahein (tunica externa, media, intima) hoti hain, lekin artery ki tunica media moti, muscular aur elastic hoti hai taake zyada pressure seh sake; vein ki tunica media patli aur thori muscular hoti hai.

rows: Moti tunica media, muscle aur elastic fibres
Patli tunica media, thori muscular, kam elastic fibres
Zyada blood pressure sehti hai
Kam pressure par blood le jati hai
Khaali ho kar bhi khokhli nali rehti hai
Khaali ho kar pichak jati hai
Valves nahi hote
Semilunar valves hote hain

blocks.prompt:
2. Enlist the four valves present in heart and also state their locations.
Dil ke chaar valves ke naam aur un ki jagah likhein.
blocks.explanation:
1. Tricuspid valve: right atrium aur right ventricle ke darmiyan.
2. Bicuspid (mitral) valve: left atrium aur left ventricle ke darmiyan.
3. Pulmonary (semilunar) valve: pulmonary artery (trunk) ki jar mein.
4. Aortic (semilunar) valve: aorta ki jar mein.

blocks.prompt:
3. State the phases of heartbeat.
Heartbeat (dil ki dharkan) ke phases bataein.
blocks.explanation:
1. Diastole (taqreeban 0.4 sec): atria aur ventricles dheele; atria blood se bharte hain.
2. Atrial systole (taqreeban 0.1 sec): dono atria contract ho kar blood ventricles mein dhakelte hain.
3. Ventricular systole (taqreeban 0.3 sec): dono ventricles contract ho kar blood pulmonary arteries aur aorta mein pump karte hain.

blocks.prompt:
4. List the principles and uses of Electrocardiogram.
Electrocardiogram (ECG) ke usool aur faide likhein.
blocks.explanation:
Usool: dil ka impulse aik bohat halki electric current banata hai jo jism ki satah tak pohanchti hai; dil ke dono taraf jild par lage electrodes yeh potentials pakarte hain aur electrocardiograph inhein P, QRS aur T waves ki shakal mein record karta hai.
Faide: dil ke conduction system ki kharabiyan pehchanna, maslan arrhythmia (be-tarteeb dharkan), heart block, bundle branch block, ischaemia aur heart attack.

blocks.prompt:
5. Define angiography and angioplasty.
Angiography aur angioplasty ki tareef karein.
blocks.explanation:
Angiography: dil ki blood vessels ya chambers ka X-ray mua'ina jis mein catheter se dye (contrast medium) dala jata hai taake coronary arteries ki tangi ya clot nazar aaye.
Angioplasty: band ya tang artery ko andar chhota balloon phula kar kholne ka tareeqa; aksar stent (jaali ki nali) chhor diya jata hai taake artery khuli rahe.

blocks.prompt:
6. What is meant by Purkinje fibres?
Purkinje fibres se kya muraad hai?
blocks.explanation: Purkinje fibres ventricles ki deewaron mein woh conducting fibres hain jin par AV bundle (bundle of His) ki left aur right shakhein khatam hoti hain. Yeh impulse ko ventricles ki deewar mein phailate hain taake dono ventricles taqreeban aik saath contract hon.

blocks.prompt:
7. What do you mean by vasoconstriction and vasodilation?
Vasoconstriction aur vasodilation se kya muraad hai?
blocks.explanation:
Vasoconstriction: arterioles ke circular muscles ka sukarna, jis se arterioles tang aur blood ka bahao kam ho jata hai.
Vasodilation: in muscles ka dheela hona, jis se arterioles khulti hain aur blood ka bahao barhta hai (maslan jab kisi tissue ka kaam barh jaye).

blocks.prompt:
8. What is the rate of blood flow in different types of blood vessels?
Mukhtalif blood vessels mein blood ke bahao ki raftaar kya hai?
blocks.explanation: Aorta mein sab se zyada (450-500 mm/sec), arteries aur arterioles mein kam hoti hui capillaries mein sab se kam (taqreeban 1 mm/sec; kitab mein "01 mm/sec"), phir venules, veins aur vena cavae mein dobara barhti hai (250-300 mm/sec). Yeh farq vessels ke kul cross-section ki wajah se hai.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Darya chaurha ho jaye to paani aahista behta hai, tang ho to tez. Capillaries akeli patli hain lekin karoron hain, is liye in ka kul phailao sab se zyada aur raftaar sab se kam hai; is se exchange ke liye waqt milta hai.

blocks.prompt:
9. State the role of baroreceptors and volume receptors in regulating the blood pressure.
Blood pressure ko control karne mein baroreceptors aur volume receptors ka kirdar bataein.
blocks.explanation:
Baroreceptors (carotid arteries aur aortic arch mein pressure receptors): pressure girne par dimagh ko signal dete hain; dimagh dil ki raftaar aur zor barhata hai aur vasoconstriction karata hai, pressure wapas normal.
Dimagh ke volume receptors: blood ka volume kam ho to pyaas lagate hain aur ADH nikalwate hain, jis se gurde paani rok lete hain (aur arterioles tang hoti hain); volume aur pressure barhte hain. (Zyada volume se right atrium khinche to ANH nikal kar pressure kam karta hai.)

blocks.prompt:
10. Differentiate between thrombus and embolus.
Thrombus aur embolus mein farq bataein.
blocks.explanation: Thrombus woh clot hai jo apni jagah par rehta hai; embolus woh thrombus hai jo toot kar blood ke saath aage chala jata hai.

rows: Blood vessel mein blood ke ajza ka thos lothra (clot)
Woh thrombus jo apni jagah se hil kar toot jaye
Jahan bana wahin ruka rehta hai
Blood ke saath kisi aur jagah pohanch jata hai
Wahin vessel band karta hai (coronary artery: heart attack)
Door ki vessel band karta hai (dimagh mein: stroke)

blocks.prompt:
1. Describe the structure of the walls of heart and rationalize the thickness of the walls of each chamber.
Dil ki deewaron ki banawat bayan karein aur har chamber ki deewar ki motai ki wajah bataein.
blocks.explanation:
Dil pericardium ki thaili mein band hai: bahar fibrous pericardium (mazboot connective tissue jo dil ko chot se bachata aur zyada phailne se rokta hai) aur andar do tahon wala serous pericardium (parietal aur visceral). Dono ke darmiyan pericardial cavity mein 50 mL tak fluid hota hai jo dil ko chikna rakhta aur infection se bachata hai.
Dil ki deewar (teen tahein):
1. Epicardium: bahar wali tah (visceral pericardium).
2. Myocardium: darmiyani aur sab se moti tah, cardiac muscle ki bani; contract ho kar blood pump karti hai.
3. Endocardium: epithelial cells ki aik tah jo chambers ke andar ki lining hai.
Har chamber ki motai:
1. Atria ki deewar patli: yeh sirf veins se blood lete hain aur thore faasle par neeche ventricles mein dhakelte hain.
2. Ventricles ki deewar moti: yeh blood ko dil se bahar lambi vessels mein pump karte hain.
3. Left ventricle ki deewar right se taqreeban 3 guna moti: left poore jism mein blood bhejta hai (systemic circulation, zyada pressure), right sirf qareeb ke phephron tak (pulmonary circulation, kam pressure).
4. Isi wajah se interventricular septum interatrial septum se kahin mota hai.

blocks.prompt:
2. Describe the flow of blood through heart as regulated by the valves.
Valves ke zariye control hone wale dil mein blood ke bahao ko bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
Dil double pump hai; right side deoxygenated (bina oxygen) aur left side oxygenated blood sambhalti hai, aur valves bahao ko aik hi taraf rakhte hain.
Right side (pulmonary circulation):
1. Superior aur inferior vena cava jism ka deoxygenated blood right atrium mein late hain.
2. Right atrium yeh blood tricuspid valve se right ventricle ko deta hai.
3. Right ventricle contract ho to tricuspid valve band (atrium mein wapsi nahi) aur blood pulmonary semilunar valve se pulmonary trunk mein jata hai, jo pulmonary arteries ban kar phephron tak jata hai.
Left side (systemic circulation):
4. Pulmonary veins phephron ka oxygenated blood left atrium mein lati hain.
5. Left atrium yeh blood bicuspid (mitral) valve se left ventricle ko deta hai.
6. Left ventricle contract ho to bicuspid valve band aur blood aortic semilunar valve se aorta mein, phir poore jism (siwaye phephron) mein.
Valves ka kaam: ventricular systole mein tricuspid aur bicuspid band ("lubb") aur semilunar valves khule; ventricles dheele hon to pulmonary aur aortic valves band ("dubb"), taake arteries se blood ventricles mein wapas na aaye.

blocks.prompt:
3. Explain how a heartbeat is initiated and controlled.
Bataein ke heartbeat kaise shuru aur control hoti hai.
blocks.explanation:
Shuru hona (conduction system):
1. SA node (pacemaker), right atrium ki oopar wali deewar mein cardiac muscle cells ka chhota guchha, atria ki deewaron ko electric signals bhejta hai aur dono atria aik saath contract hote hain.
2. Signal interatrial septum ke neeche AV node tak pohanchta hai. Taqreeban 0.15 sec ki der (delay) hoti hai taake atrial systole ventricular systole se pehle poora ho jaye.
3. AV node se signal interventricular septum mein AV bundle (bundle of His) mein jata hai jo left aur right shakhon mein batt jata hai.
4. Shakhein ventricles ki deewar mein Purkinje fibres par khatam hoti hain jo dono ventricles ko taqreeban aik saath contract karati hain.
Raftaar ka control:
1. Normal raftaar (taqreeban 70 dafa fi minute) pacemaker aur AV node qaim rakhte hain.
2. Dimagh bhi asar dalta hai: bukhar aur exercise mein us ka control centre SA aur AV nodes ko signal de kar raftaar barhata hai; neend ya aaraam mein kam karta hai.
3. Agar SA node kamzor ho ya signal ruk jaye to artificial pacemaker (battery wala aala jo AV node ke qareeb lagaya jata hai) signals de kar normal dharkan chalata hai.

blocks.prompt:
4. Describe the detailed structure of arteries, veins and capillaries.
Arteries, veins aur capillaries ki tafseeli banawat bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
Arteries (blood ko dil se door le jati hain; pulmonary arteries ke siwa sab oxygenated):
1. Darmiyan mein lumen (khokhla raasta), gird teen tahein.
2. Tunica externa (adventitia): connective aur elastic tissue.
3. Tunica media: moti muscle aur elastic fibres; ventricular systole ka zyada pressure sehti hai.
4. Tunica intima: endothelial cells ki patli tah.
5. Arterioles mein batt jati hain jin mein elastic tissue se zyada circular muscle hota hai (vasoconstriction/vasodilation).
Capillaries (arterioles ke batne se banti hain; mil kar venules banati hain):
1. Deewar endothelial cells ki sirf aik tah; andar ka qutar taqreeban 8 micrometre, RBCs aik qatar mein guzarte hain.
2. Har tissue tak pohanchti hain; koi cell capillary se 100 micrometre se door nahi.
3. Cheezon ka tabadla cells ke andar se, cells ke darmiyani faaslon se, ya endocytosis aur exocytosis se; bahar risne wala fluid interstitial fluid banta hai.
4. Capillary loops ke shuru mein pre-capillary sphincters bahao control karte hain.
Veins (blood ko dil ki taraf; pulmonary veins ke siwa sab deoxygenated):
1. Wohi teen tahein: tunica externa connective aur elastic tissue; tunica media patli, thori muscular, kam elastic fibres; tunica intima endothelium.
2. Pressure kam hai is liye deewar patli; khaali vein pichak jati hai.
3. Semilunar valves blood ko wapas jane se rokte hain; ird gird ke muscles ka dabao blood ko dil ki taraf dhakelta hai.
4. Chhoti veins mil kar bari aur aakhir vena cavae banti hain jo right atrium mein khulti hain.

blocks.prompt:
5. Describe the role of precapillary sphincters in regulating the flow of blood through capillaries.
Capillaries mein blood ke bahao ko control karne mein precapillary sphincters ka kirdar bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
1. Capillaries mein blood ki miqdaar unhein tang ya khula kar ke control hoti hai: nervous signal tang karta hai aur histamine jaise chemicals khol dete hain.
2. Kuch capillaries arterioles aur venules se doosri capillaries ke loops (chakkar) ke zariye juri hoti hain.
3. Har loop ke darwaze par muscle ka chhalla hota hai jise pre-capillary sphincter kehte hain.
4. Sphincter sukre to loop band aur blood un capillaries ko chhor kar seedha arteriole se venule chala jata hai; sphincter dheela ho to loop khulta hai aur blood capillary bed se guzarta hai.
5. Yun sphincters kaam karte tissues (jinhein zyada O₂ chahiye aur zyada CO₂ nikalni hai) ko zyada aur aaram wale tissues ko kam blood bhejte hain.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Sphincter ko nalke ki tonti samjhein: tonti khuli to paani (blood) capillaries mein, band to paani doosre raaste se aage nikal jata hai.

blocks.prompt:
6. Write the components of pulmonary circulation.
Pulmonary circulation ke hisse likhein.
blocks.explanation:
Pulmonary circulation deoxygenated blood ko phephron tak le jati aur oxygenated blood dil mein wapas lati hai. Is ke hisse tarteeb se:
1. Right ventricle → pulmonary trunk (deoxygenated blood wali bari artery).
2. Right aur left pulmonary arteries, daen aur baen phephre tak.
3. Har phephre ke andar pulmonary arterioles.
4. Alveoli ke gird lung capillaries, jahan blood oxygenated hota hai.
5. Pulmonary venules → pulmonary veins (har phephre se left aur right).
6. Pulmonary veins left atrium mein khulti hain.

blocks.prompt:
7. What are the main components of coronary, hepatic-portal and renal circulation?
Coronary, hepatic-portal aur renal circulation ke bare hisse kya hain?
blocks.explanation:
Teenon systemic circulation ke hisse hain.
Coronary circulation (dil ki deewar ko blood):
1. Right aur left coronary arteries aorta ke shuru se nikalti hain.
2. Dil ke muscle mein chhoti arteries, arterioles aur capillaries mein batti hain.
3. Capillaries mil kar venules aur coronary veins banati hain.
4. Coronary veins mil kar coronary sinus banati hain jo right atrium mein khulta hai; chhoti coronary veins seedha right atrium mein girti hain.
Hepatic portal circulation (portal system: veins jo capillaries par khatam hon):
1. Hepatic portal vein spleen aur alimentary canal (oesophagus ke neeche se anal canal ke oopar tak) ka blood jama karti hai.
2. Hazam shuda khoraak wala yeh blood liver ki capillaries mein le jati hai.
3. Liver nuqsan deh cheezein nikalta aur ghiza jama karta hai.
4. Hepatic veins liver se blood dil ki taraf (inferior vena cava ke zariye) le jati hain.
Renal circulation (gurdon ko blood):
1. Right aur left renal arteries oxygenated blood gurdon tak le jati hain.
2. Har aik chhoti arteries aur phir afferent arterioles mein batti hai jo nephrons ko blood deti hain.
3. Har afferent arteriole glomerulus ki capillaries banati hai.
4. Yeh mil kar efferent arteriole banati hain jo peritubular capillaries (cortex mein) aur vasa recta (medulla mein) banati hai.
5. Yeh mil kar venules aur chhoti veins, aur aakhir renal vein banati hain.

blocks.prompt:
8. Define blood pressure and explain systolic and diastolic pressure.
Blood pressure ki tareef karein aur systolic aur diastolic pressure samjhayein.
blocks.explanation:
Blood pressure woh zor hai jo blood vessels ki andar ki deewaron par lagata hai; yahi zor blood ko dil se poore capillary network tak chalata hai. Aam tor par is se muraad systemic arteries ka pressure hai. Yeh aorta mein sab se zyada aur arteries mein aahista aahista kam hota hai.
Systolic pressure: ventricles contract hon (ventricular systole) to blood aorta aur pulmonary arteries mein dhakela jata hai aur pressure tezi se barhta hai. Yeh zyada se zyada pressure systolic hai; normal jawan mein taqreeban 120 mm Hg.
Diastolic pressure: ventricles dheele hon (diastole) to pressure girta hai. Agli dharkan se pehle arteries mein bacha sab se kam pressure diastolic hai; normal jawan mein taqreeban 75-85 mm Hg.
Blood pressure systolic/diastolic likha jata hai, aam tor par 120/80, aur sphygmomanometer (mercury column wala aala) se napa jata hai. Elastic arteries ki baqaida dharkan pulse kehlati hai.

blocks.prompt:
9. Define the term thrombus and differentiate between thrombus and embolus.
Thrombus ki tareef karein aur thrombus aur embolus mein farq bataein.
blocks.explanation: Thrombus: blood vessel mein blood ke ajza ka thos lothra (clot) jo vessel ko poora ya kuch band kar de. Is ka banna (thrombosis) vessel ki lining ki jalan ya infection, lambi be-harkati se blood ka aahista bahao, ya pneumonia, TB aur emphysema jaisi bimariyon se ho sakta hai.

rows: Blood vessel mein bana clot
Woh thrombus jo apni jagah se hil gaya
Jahan bana wahin rehta hai
Blood ke saath kisi aur jagah chala jata hai
Apni jagah vessel band karta hai
Kisi aur jagah vessel band karta hai (thromboembolism)
Coronary artery mein heart attack
Dimagh ki vessel mein phans kar stroke

blocks.prompt:
10. Identify the factors causing atherosclerosis and arteriosclerosis.
Atherosclerosis aur arteriosclerosis paida karne wale factors pehchanein.
blocks.explanation:
Atherosclerosis ("arteries ke andar jamao"):
1. Artery ki deewar mein cholesterol (sab se bari wajah) aur doosre charbi wale maadde jama hona.
2. Smooth muscle cells, fibrin aur cells ke malbe ka ghair maamooli jamao.
3. Is se artery tang hoti hai aur thrombus ka khatra barhta hai, jis se heart attack hota hai.
(Chapter se bahar: smoking, charbi wali ghiza, motapa, warzish ki kami, hypertension aur diabetes khatra barhate hain; chapter inhein dil ki bimari ke risk factors kehta hai.)
Arteriosclerosis ("arteries ki deewar ka sakht hona"):
1. Arteries ki deewar mein calcium jama hona.
2. Shadeed atherosclerosis aksar arteriosclerosis ban jata hai.
3. Artery normal tareeqe se phail nahi sakti, bahao kam aur dil ko zyada mehnat karni parti hai.

blocks.prompt:
11. Write notes on Angina pectoris, heart attack, and heart failure.
Angina pectoris, heart attack aur heart failure par notes likhein.
blocks.explanation:
Angina pectoris:
Seene ka dard jo tab hota hai jab coronary arteries lipids (khaas tor par cholesterol) jama hone se tang ho jayein. Yeh pareshani ya mehnat ke waqt hota hai aur batata hai ke dil ko oxygen ki zaroorat supply se zyada hai; yeh aane wale heart attack ki warning hai.
Heart attack (myocardial infarction):
Jab coronary artery mein blood ruk jaye (maslan thrombus se) to dil ke muscle ke kuch hisse ko oxygen aur ghiza nahi milti aur woh mar jata hai. Agar kharab hissa chhota ho aur doosri vessels phail kar blood de sakein to sehat ho sakti hai. Ilaaj: dawa, angioplasty/stent ya coronary bypass surgery.
Heart failure (congestive heart failure):
Lamba hypertension dil ke muscle ko kamzor kar deta hai; dil theek pump nahi kar pata aur tissues ki zaroorat ke mutabiq blood nahi pohanchta. Blood dil aur phephron mein ruk jata hai. Congestive heart failure mein seene ka dard (angina) nahi hota.

blocks.prompt:
12. Outline the main principles of coronary bypass surgery and angioplasty.
Coronary bypass surgery aur angioplasty ke bunyaadi usool bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
Dono tab kiye jate hain jab lifestyle ki tabdeeli aur dawa se faida na ho, ya tang coronary arteries se heart attack ka khatra ho.
Coronary bypass surgery:
1. Usool: coronary artery ke band hisse ke gird blood ka naya raasta banana.
2. Surgeon mareez ki taang, baazu, seene ya pait se aik sehatmand blood vessel leta hai.
3. Is ke sire rukawat ke oopar aur neeche jore jate hain; blood band hisse ko chhor kar dil ke muscle tak pohanchta hai.
4. Yeh open ya dharakte dil (beating-heart) par ho sakti hai. Yeh atherosclerosis ka ilaaj nahi, is liye lifestyle (smoking chhorna, kam charbi, warzish, BP aur diabetes control) phir bhi zaroori hai.
Angioplasty aur stenting:
1. Usool: tang artery ko andar se chaurha karna.
2. X-ray ki madad se patli wire wala catheter tang coronary artery mein dala jata hai.
3. Chhota sausage jaisa balloon wire par tang hisse tak le ja kar phulaya jata hai jo artery ko khol deta hai.
4. Dye dal kar dekha jata hai ke artery khul gayi.
5. Stenting: balloon par lagi phailne wali stainless-steel jaali ki nali (stent) balloon ke saath phailti hai; balloon nikal liya jata hai aur stent artery ko khula rakhta hai.

blocks.prompt:
13. Define hypertension and describe the factors that regulate blood pressure and can lead to hypertension and hypotension.
Hypertension ki tareef karein aur woh factors bayan karein jo blood pressure control karte hain aur hypertension aur hypotension ka sabab ban sakte hain.
blocks.explanation:
Hypertension: blood pressure ka lambe arse tak barha rehna, jab yeh musalsal 140/90 se oopar rahe.
Blood pressure control karne wale factors:
1. Carotid arteries aur aortic arch ke baroreceptors: pressure gire to dimagh dil ki raftaar aur zor barhata aur vasoconstriction karata hai.
2. Dil ki raftaar aur zor (SA aur AV nodes aur dimagh se).
3. Arterioles ki chaurai: vasoconstriction pressure barhati, vasodilation kam karti hai.
4. Blood ka volume, hormones se: ADH (volume kam hone par) gurdon se paani rokwata aur arterioles tang karta hai; khinche hue right atrium ka ANH peshab mein namak aur paani zyada nikal kar volume aur pressure kam karta hai.
Hypertension ki wajuhaat:
1. Nervous ya hormonal control mein kharabi.
2. Pareshani (stress), motapa, zyada namak aur smoking.
3. Moroosi (hereditary) wajuhaat.
4. Arteriosclerosis (sakht arteries) aur gurdon ka nuqsan, jo namak aur paani rok kar pressure aur barhata hai.
Asraat: vessels ka phatna (brain haemorrhage), kamzor dil (congestive heart failure), gurdon ka nuqsan.
Hypotension (chapter se bahar): blood pressure normal se kam (taqreeban 90/60 ya kam). Yeh blood volume kam hone (khoon behna, ulti ya dast se paani ki kami), zyada vasodilation, kamzor ya aahista dil, ya baroreceptors aur hormones ke control ki nakami se hota hai; chakkar aur behoshi aati hai.

blocks.prompt:
14. List the changes in life styles that can protect man from hypertension and cardiac problems.
Lifestyle ki woh tabdeeliyan likhein jo insaan ko hypertension aur dil ki bimariyon se bacha sakti hain.
blocks.explanation:
1. Smoking chhorna (sab se aham).
2. Namak kam khana.
3. Ghiza mein khaas qisam ki charbi (saturated fat aur cholesterol) kam karna; phal, sabziyan aur fibre zyada.
4. Jismani harkat barhana (baqaida warzish); lambi be-harkati se bachna.
5. Wazan normal rakhna (motapa na hone dena).
6. Pareshani (stress) ko qaboo karna.
7. BP aur diabetes ko baqaida check-up aur dawa se control rakhna.
8. (Chapter se bahar) Sharaab se bachna aur poori neend lena.

blocks.prompt:
15. Describe the structure and role of lymph capillaries, lymph vessels and lymph ducts.
Lymph capillaries, lymph vessels aur lymph ducts ki banawat aur kirdar bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
Lymph capillaries:
1. Chhoti vessels jin ke sire interstitial fluid mein band (blind) hote hain.
2. Blood capillaries se zyada permeable, is liye bare molecules (proteins) bhi andar ja sakte hain.
3. Interstitial fluid ka pressure use andar dhakelta hai; andar ja kar yeh lymph kehlata hai.
4. Aanton ke villi mein inhein lacteals kehte hain jo charbi (chylomicrons) jazb karti hain.
Lymph vessels (lymphatics):
1. Lymph capillaries ke milne se banti hain.
2. In mein valves hote hain jo lymph ko wapas jane se rokte hain.
3. Lymph skeletal muscles ki harkat, andaruni aazaa ki harkat aur saans ki harkat se chalta hai.
4. Kuch jagahon par lymph nodes se guzarti hain (kai afferent vessels andar, aik efferent bahar), jahan lymphocytes aur macrophages lymph ko saaf karte aur bacteria aur viruses ko khatam karte hain.
Lymph ducts:
1. Lymph vessels mil kar do bari ducts banati hain: right lymphatic duct aur thoracic duct.
2. Yeh tarteeb se right aur left subclavian veins mein khulti hain aur lymph ko blood mein wapas de deti hain.
System ka kirdar: zaid fluid (rozana taqreeban 3 litre), proteins aur doosri cheezein blood mein wapas lana, charbi jazb karna aur jism ko germs se bachana.

blocks.prompt:
1. Why is the pressure in the pulmonary circulation lower than in the systemic circulation?
Pulmonary circulation mein pressure systemic circulation se kam kyun hota hai?
blocks.explanation:
1. Right ventricle sirf qareeb ke phephron tak blood bhejta hai (chhota raasta, kam rukawat), is liye us ki deewar left se taqreeban 3 guna patli aur pressure kam hota hai.
2. Left ventricle ko poore jism mein blood bhejna hota hai (lamba raasta, zyada rukawat), is liye zyada pressure banata hai.
3. (Chapter se bahar) Kam pressure alveoli ki nazuk capillaries ko bachata hai: zyada pressure fluid ko alveoli mein dhakel deta (pulmonary oedema) aur gas exchange kharab hota; aahista bahao gas exchange ko zyada waqt bhi deta hai.

blocks.prompt:
2. Why is it so important for the human heart to develop early and begin functioning within the developing embryo?
Bachte hue embryo mein insaani dil ka jaldi banna aur kaam shuru karna itna zaroori kyun hai?
blocks.explanation: (Chapter se bahar) Embryo barhta hai to jaldi itna bara ho jata hai ke sirf diffusion se har cell tak oxygen aur ghiza nahi pohanch sakti. Is liye shuru hi se kaam karta dil chahiye jo blood ke zariye oxygen aur ghiza (placenta se) har barhte tissue tak pohanchaye aur CO₂ aur fuzlaat (wastes) wapas le jaye. Is circulation ke baghair baqi aazaa ban hi nahi sakte, is liye dil sab se pehle kaam karne wala organ hai (taqreeban 3rd-4th hafte dharakna shuru karta hai). Kitab ka box bhi embryo ke dil ke khaas raaste (interatrial foramen, ductus arteriosus) dikhata hai.

blocks.prompt:
3. Justify how vasoconstriction or vasodilation is reflective of emotions.
Saabit karein ke vasoconstriction ya vasodilation jazbaat ki akkaasi kaise karte hain.
blocks.explanation:
Arterioles ke circular muscles nervous aur endocrine systems ke control mein hain, aur yeh system jazbaat par react karte hain.
(Chapter se bahar, misalein:)
1. Sharmindagi ya ghussa: chehre ki jild mein vasodilation se chehra laal ho jata hai (sharm se surkh hona).
2. Dar ya sadma: adrenaline aur sympathetic nerves jild mein vasoconstriction karte hain, chehra peela par jata hai aur blood muscles ki taraf jata hai.
3. Pareshani ya ghussa: jism bhar mein vasoconstriction blood pressure barhata hai; isi liye stress hypertension ki wajah hai.
Yun jild ka rang aur blood pressure jazbaat ke saath badalte hain.

blocks.prompt:
4. Justify in what way the blood circulatory system is dependent on the lymphatic system.
Saabit karein ke blood circulatory system lymphatic system par kis tarah munhasir hai.
blocks.explanation:
1. Capillaries ka pressure plasma se fluid ko musalsal tissues mein risata hai; rozana taqreeban 3 litre zyada fluid blood capillaries se nikalta hai jitna wapas aata hai.
2. Lymphatic system yeh zaid fluid aur bahar nikle proteins jama kar ke thoracic aur right lymphatic ducts ke zariye subclavian veins mein blood ko wapas deta hai.
3. Is ke baghair blood ka volume aur pressure gir jata aur tissues mein paani jama ho jata (soojan, oedema).
4. Yeh aanton se charbi (lacteals) bhi jazb karta hai aur is ke lymph nodes aur spleen germs ko saaf karte hain, is liye blood saaf aur poora rehta hai.

blocks.prompt:
5. Interpret why the swelling of the lymph nodes is a cause of concern.
Wazahat karein ke lymph nodes ka soojna fikr ki baat kyun hai.
blocks.explanation:
1. Lymph nodes lymph ko filter karte hain; un ke lymphocytes aur macrophages bacteria aur viruses ko khatam karte hain. Soojan ka matlab hai ke woh kisi infection se lar rahe hain.
2. Mumps jaisi bimariyon mein dardnaak soojan zyada tar mare hue lymphocytes aur macrophages ke jama hone se hoti hai.
3. (Chapter se bahar) Lambi, be-dard, sakht ya barhti soojan TB ya cancer (maslan lymphoma, ya lymph ke zariye phailta cancer) jaisi sangeen bimari ki nishani ho sakti hai, is liye doctor ko dikhana chahiye.

blocks.prompt:
6. Trace the path of lymph from a lymph capillary until it is returned to the blood.
Lymph capillary se blood mein wapsi tak lymph ka raasta bataein.
blocks.explanation: Interstitial fluid → band siron wali lymph capillaries mein (ab lymph kehlata hai) → bari lymph vessels (valves wali) → afferent vessels se lymph nodes mein, jahan saaf hota hai → efferent lymph vessel → bari lymph vessels → lymph ducts: right lymphatic duct (right subclavian vein mein) ya thoracic duct (left subclavian vein mein) → blood, dil mein jane se pehle.
